challenged_premise: Arbitrarily small selected-three-eigenspace row leverage, together with source-valid physical-coordinate conditioning of selected mass <1, forces a small-whitened-block-mass approximate block decomposition satisfying QFORM-DIFFUSE-APPROX-BLOCK-STABILITY-v1.
summary: For the exact three-bank frame r_j=m^{-1/2}1_{G_j}, Lambda=diag(1,1,-1), C=I-RR^T, A=I-2r_3r_3^T, selected row leverage is 1/m -> 0. After every conditioning H with eta<1 and every physical block partition of whitened mass mu<1/3, every block-diagonal approximant C0 obeys ||C[T,T]-C0|| >= (1-eta)sqrt(2)/3. This makes the prior B08 approximate-block stability criterion impossible. The QFORM target is not refuted: the same family has a definite original-coordinate 2x2 principal block I_2 and hence ||p_Q||_infinity<=pi by the completed physical principal-pair theorem.
